description: Rīgas ielu sarkanās līnijas is a dataset listed in data.gov.lv, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rīgas dome. The data set shall contain information on the red lines of streets of Riga City Council, which delimit the territory necessary for the construction of the road, street and access road (including utility corridors) from the territory to be built-up or otherwise used. They are defined by existing spatial plans, local plans and detailed plans. Coverage: Rīgas dome. The portal shows the English title as "Red Lines of Riga Streets" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Rīgas dome. Its keywords include GEO RĪGA, Rīgas pašvaldība, Rīgas Dome, Aizsargjoslas, Sarkanās līnijas. The listing shows 5 download or service links in DXF, GPKG, KML, SHP. The listing shows 2024-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lv.
